content.text: /ext:medcp Among elderly, what are the most frequent nutritional deficiency diagnoses?

I'll query the MedCP electronic health records database to find the most frequent nutritional deficiency diagnoses in elderly patients. Let me start by checking what tables are available and then run the query.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Top nutritional deficiency diagnoses in elderly (age >= 65)
SELECT
  c.concept_name AS diagnosis,
  c.concept_code,
  c.vocabulary_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS num_patients,
  COUNT(*) AS total_occurrences
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
JOIN omop.person p ON co.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE 
  ROUND((DATEDIFF(DATE(co.condition_start_date), DATE(p.year_of_birth)) / 365.25) + p.year_of_birth, 0)::int >= 65
  AND c.domain_id IN ('Medical Status', 'Condition')
  AND c.standard_concept IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%deficiency%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%malnutrition%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%vitamin deficient%'
    OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%vit a%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%vit b1%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%vit b6%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%vit b12%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%vit d%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%vit e%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%folate%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%iron def%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%zinc% deficient%'
       OR LOWER(c.vocabulary_id || '~' || c.concept_code) ILIKE '%copper% def%'
  )
GROUP BY c.concept_name, c.concept_code, c.vocabulary_id
ORDER BY num_patients DESC
LIMIT 25;
